Cookie Policy

Effective date: 10 September 2026 · VF Empire Corp Ltd, Malta, EU

This site uses no advertising cookies, no analytics cookies and no tracking of any kind. We build private-by-architecture systems, and the company website behaves the same way.

1. What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device. Related technologies (localStorage, sessionStorage) store data in your browser in a similar way. EU law (the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC as implemented in Malta, together with the GDPR) requires consent for any storage that is not strictly necessary for a service you have requested.

2. What vfempire.com stores

NAMETYPEPURPOSEDURATIONCATEGORY
vf-consentlocalStorageRemembers your accept/decline choice in our cookie notice so we do not ask on every visit. Never transmitted anywhere.Until you clear itStrictly necessary
__cf_bm / cf_clearance (only if issued)Cookie (Cloudflare)Bot management and security challenges by our infrastructure provider, to protect the Site against automated abuse. Set only when Cloudflare’s security layer requires it.Minutes to hoursStrictly necessary

There are no first-party analytics, no third-party pixels, no fingerprinting and no cross-site identifiers.

3. Why we still show a notice

We want you to hear it from us. And if we ever introduce an optional category (for example privacy-respecting analytics), the consent mechanics are already in place. Nothing optional loads today whether you accept or decline; declining changes nothing except recording your preference.

4. Managing your choice

You can reset your choice at any time:

You can also clear storage in your browser settings (usually under Privacy → Clear browsing data), or block cookies for this site; the Site works without them.

5. Changes

If we add a storage category, we update this page and the consent notice before anything new is stored, and anything non-essential stays off until you opt in.

6. Contact

Questions: info@vfempire.com · See also our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
